title: Headless Autonomous Agent Memory Runtime
description: Defines operational responsibilities of the autonomous memory product and its host. The synchronous text lifecycle and optional budgeted semantic recall controller are implemented; the full cognitive architecture remains a target. This file is not a declaration that every capability is complete.

product_boundary.primary_deliverable: A persistent cognitive memory runtime integrated into the agent inference lifecycle
product_boundary.host_integration: The host binds a stable brain identity and lifecycle adapter at initialization; the adapter automatically orchestrates every turn
product_boundary.context_authority: The runtime manages memory context; the host retains authority over system rules, tool protocols, and action permissions
product_boundary.identity: Brain identity remains stable across models and processes; participants, relationships, tasks, and branches have independent scopes
product_boundary.mcp_role: Supplementary active exploration, diagnostics, corrections, and authorized deletion; not a required trigger for automatic memory operation

integration_independence.primary_audience: Agents using models through API keys; direct integrations and third-party hosts share the same core
integration_independence.core_ownership: Persistent memory, provenance, identity and scope, recall, learning, decay, and recovery rules
integration_independence.adapter_responsibility: Translate actual events, map stable identities, integrate lifecycle hooks, and report actual delivery outcomes; do not access the database directly or maintain another authoritative memory copy
integration_independence.packaging: Third-party dependencies belong in optional adapter packages; the core does not import chat frameworks
integration_independence.turn_ownership: Each turn has exactly one lifecycle orchestrator; plugins and model proxies must not duplicate capture, injection, or generation
integration_independence.continuity: An authorized model or adapter change can bind the original brain; uninstalling an adapter does not delete core data
integration_independence.identity_mapping: Cross-platform participants and conversations are linked explicitly through trusted configuration only; do not merge by nickname or model inference or automatically cross private/group-chat scopes
integration_independence.current_boundary: The core, desktop chat command, and open_agent Python sessions have no QQ-framework dependency. The direct entry supports synchronous Chat Completions text, durable database reservations for conversation/branch exclusion across hosts, and explicit recovery with delivery receipts. All API processes must be upgraded together; external delivery remains dependent on host acknowledgements and idempotency. A model-compatible gateway and QQ adapter plugins have not shipped

full_integration_requirements: Authenticated stable agent, participant, conversation, branch, and message identifiers
Automatic receipt of inputs, message revisions, tool results, and generation-cancellation events
Ability to read and replace memory context before every model call that needs memory, rather than only appending history
Preservation of necessary recent conversation, tool call/result pairs, and host system rules
Separate generation state from actual delivery state; retain unknown without delivery confirmation
Check working revisions and dependency generations before commit; duplicate callbacks remain idempotent
Reconstruct working state and continue durable queues after interruption or recovery
Continuously report actually verified capabilities; explicitly degrade when essential control is unavailable

automatic_cycle.trigger: The host receives input, tool results, or external feedback
automatic_cycle.behavior: Reliably capture actual events, distinguishing drafts, plans, expressions, and actual outcomes; do not depend on the primary agent deciding to call a save tool

automatic_cycle.trigger: Before inference or when a new information gap arises during the turn
automatic_cycle.behavior: Form recall needs from current goals, references, relationships, and unfinished matters; activate candidates and check evidence; continue searching, clarify, or stop within the total budget

automatic_cycle.trigger: The model is about to infer
automatic_cycle.behavior: Build a bounded workspace from persistent state, preserving sources, time, and unknowns; compacting temporary context does not alter the factual sources of long-term memory

automatic_cycle.trigger: Receipt of delivery confirmation, tool execution outcomes, or a cancellation signal
automatic_cycle.behavior: Commit actual outcomes and update working state, unfinished matters, and grounded learning candidates; a model's claim of success is not execution success

automatic_cycle.trigger: New evidence, conflicts, task outcomes, or pending backlog
automatic_cycle.behavior: Incrementally form generalizations, associations, and methods while preserving counterexamples and applicability; adjust activation and detail policies; reflection without new evidence does not increase truthfulness

automatic_cycle.trigger: Process restart, conversation recovery, or context reconstruction
automatic_cycle.behavior: Recover from persistent state without requiring users to repeat their history or manually reimport it; apply current deletion and correction constraints before restoring old data

surfaces: Authenticated readiness, lifecycle coverage, and queue watermarks
Foreground/background cost, context usage, latency, failure, and degradation metrics
Ordered structured runtime events queryable by turn_id and trace_id
Authorized expansion of sources, versions, and policies to explain a memory decision
diagnostic_questions: Why were these memories recalled this turn, and where did the evidence come from?
Why did recall stop: sufficient information, no match, ambiguity, exceeded limits, or service failure?
Which beliefs changed after a correction, and do old conclusions still enter context?
Which organization jobs remain incomplete, and how much time and resources has each consumed?
development_observability.access: Source expansion uses the same authentication and scope checks as the memory service; logs must not become copies that bypass deletion or isolation
development_observability.failure_policy: Diagnostic-write failures must be visible; diagnostics neither replace persistence acknowledgments nor alter memory transaction outcomes

acceptance_invariants: Direct integration automatically forms, uses, and recovers memories without installing any third-party chat framework

Authorized model or host-adapter changes retain the original brain; retries do not duplicate capture or sending; uncertain delivery stops for reconciliation; correction, deletion, and scope isolation still hold
Automatic memory formation and use continue with all pages and primary-agent memory tools disabled
Business code does not manually program memory operations every turn; the host adapter guarantees lifecycle coverage
Relevant state can be recovered and old sources used correctly after restart without providing the user's historical chat window
Vague cues activate old evidence through the situation; repeating the current cue is not recall
New evidence can change existing beliefs; counterexamples, corrections, and unsupported model outputs are handled separately
Complete traces explain provenance, policies, stopping reasons, and cost without a management page or hidden reasoning
A host with only tool connectivity cannot be labeled full_lifecycle

current_implementation.scope_note: The available and remaining lists below preserve the early synchronous-runtime baseline, not the current feature inventory. Optional semantic consolidation and later scoped real-model evaluations are documented in the linked implementation and evaluation reports. Full autonomous-runtime acceptance remains incomplete.
available: Persistent turns, leases, and atomic output capture
Generated-output source dependencies and deletion propagation
Recent conversational context bounded by time and scope
Optional model-driven cue search, ambiguity assessment, and source selection
Server-revalidated persistent recall plans and deterministic reconstruction
Persistent pre-request reservations for model calls and input bytes
Content-free recall decision traces and stopping reasons
remaining: Adapters for tool loops, streaming, and host message revisions
More complete situation understanding, association search, and real-model quality evaluation
Multiple representations of one episode, independent fragment decay, and stratified lookup
Learning of methods and unfinished matters
Complete decision, cost, and latency observability
current_implementation.verification: This early baseline used deterministic recall and generation callbacks, mocked provider HTTP, and real PostgreSQL. Its checks did not include paid model calls or a full cognitive benchmark. Later scoped real-model evaluations are reported separately; they do not establish full cognitive acceptance.

semantic_invariants: Keywords are cues only; the minimum semantic unit preserves people and relationships, negation, conditions, time, and source type.
Fragments within one episode decay independently; important specific fragments can remain for years while outdated generalizations fade.
General beliefs form incrementally from supported experiences, retaining counterexamples and valid scope; abstraction is not truthfulness.
Everyday accessibility does not mean injection every turn; read anchors and outlines first, expand as needed, and allow explicit cues to directly search deeper layers.
New evidence, external use, and user importance signals may adjust retention; model self-restatement is not independent reinforcing evidence.
Record activation decay, index demotion, and content erasure separately; actual deletion propagates through every derived representation.
Generalizations cannot fill missing details; retained content must have source support that remains valid.
acceptance_targets: Old experiences retain stable anchors and a few important fragments without ordinary details crowding the current workspace.
Cues can recover retained details from faded content; omissions in higher layers do not block direct deep retrieval.
Stratification or generalization preserves negation, conditions, source roles, and valid time.
Model self-restatement does not inflate retention priority or factual confidence.
New counterexamples update general beliefs; actual deletion cannot leak through keywords, generalizations, vectors, or caches.
Continuous maintenance does not repeatedly scan and model-summarize all history; foreground and background budgets remain bounded.
